abstracts.abstract: To amend section 149.43 and to enact sections 5507.01, 5507.02, 5507.03, 5507.04, 5507.05, and 5507.99 of the Revised Code to regulate the use of automated license plate recognition systems, mass surveillance technology, and captured surveillance data.
